scope: Simulation benchmark using simulator feedback in the outer velocity controller; never sensor-SLAM navigation or real-robot acceptance

route.heading_reference: causal controller reference_yaw; requested route/heading and feedback time are retained for independent review

speed.metric: mean absolute actual COM velocity projected on the causal nonzero reference velocity minus its norm

parking.trigger: first completed ordered route inside final XY goal with requested and actor command zero; reference velocity also zero

safety.semantics: As-recorded telemetry safety only; 50 Hz evidence does not certify unrecorded 200 Hz extrema or measured motor torque

terrain.step_functional: each actual foot supports the true tread; base proceeds at least 1 m after edge+0.5 m, then final parking; world Z rise alone is diagnostic
terrain.missing_foot_geometry_status: unverified; no strict full ramp or step pass
